notes.title: バージョンVer.1.1.0への更新のお知らせ
notes.content:
2024/08/13 Ver. 1.1.0 Updated
<Updated contents>
・Fixed a bug that when a character change is made while a spirit is being taken, and the character change is made again after the riddle is solved (the spirit that was taken is removed from the group), the removed member is restored.
・Fixed a bug in which a spirit can be taken out without being removed when the riddle is solved using a hacking program while the spirit is being taken out.
・Clarification of the existence of the key in the office.
・Slight modification of conversation.
・Changed the behavior of the enemy after firing the spirit.
・Added a sentence suggesting to spread out the saves from the viewpoint of saving in case of a deadlock.
